notes: CHK-006 has no disable iff and its hit counter uses !rst_ni (the antecedent), because the template's `!(!rst_ni) && ANTECEDENT` form could never be true for it. CHK-007 can't sample "just after edge k" without delays. It compares the falling-edge snapshot with the value sampled at the next rising edge, so it checks stability from mid-cycle to the next edge only. A change between edge k and the falling edge would not be caught. Nothing was compiled or run in Verilator.
